title: Stadium with a long span steel roof, Brisbane: structure
workplace: Stadium with three grandstands, concourses, corporate boxes and a long span steel roof, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Raker beams and columns
swms.task: Form, reinforce and pour the concrete columns and raker beams for the grandstands, working on formwork decks more than 2 m above the ground, with concrete placed by a boom pump.

facts.fallControl: Edge protection is installed around every open deck edge before work starts, and no one works outside it.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection was considered for every task, and an elevating work platform where edge protection cannot be fixed.
facts.formworkDesign: Formwork and falsework are to the engineer's design FW-110 (revision B), checked and signed off by the formwork engineer before each pour.
facts.loadLimits: Loads are placed only in the areas marked on the structural engineer's drawing S-401 (3 kPa), checked by the site engineer before loading starts.
facts.systemInstructions: The formwork system is erected to the supplier's instructions (document FS-2, revision 4) by a crew trained by the supplier.

steps: Load ply onto the deck while it is being laid
Set up the concrete pump and placing boom
